pois.name: Alaska Lounge North · approx

layout.notes: KAC Stage 1 hub_apm compile. Geometry: OSM ODbL footprints + aeroway=gate refs. Cookbook: walk only A/B/C/D+central same-building spine; N/S train-only; IAF separate. Port passenger PDFs not traced. Indoor OSM footway that touches S was cut (illegal walk).
